records.title: Keep the keys and use them backwards in December
records.header_literal: 22nd NOVEMBER, 1918. A) ZOEN v BSL (04.25 a.m., November 23d); 1600 (11/22) 2 TLE; 1 TL RIZI-180
records.readable_german: Bis auf weiteres saemtliches Schluessel ab JJ aufbewahren. Fuer Dezember dann rueckwaerts verwenden.
records.meaning: The first part instructs the recipient to retain the keys from the literal label JJ and then use them backwards for December. It does not identify a full daily schedule or establish that the instruction was followed.
notes: The native decoded wording SAEMTLICHES SCHLUESSEL is preserved without grammatical correction. The final printed AAVXA restores five coordinates omitted by the earlier OCR, while the visibly five-slot VVXAF replaces the six-character OCR group VVVXAF; these are transcription corrections, not alterations of the source.

The source advertises two parts but only the first is printed in this section. The date in the page heading and internal header is November 22; interception is November 23. JJ remains a pair of literal square labels, not an authenticated day number.
RUECKWAERTS is a direct raw reading. Which material is to be reversed, and the actual date-by-date use, cannot be established from this part alone.

records.title: A short Aufbau date correction with literal numerical labels
records.header_literal: C) BSL v ZOEN (06.09 p.m., November 22d); RIZI-88
records.readable_german: Aufbau nicht J8 oder J7, sondern J7 oder J3 Nov.
records.meaning: The message corrects date-like alternatives associated with Aufbau. The transmitted repetition of J7 on both sides is preserved; none of the labels is converted to a calendar day.
notes: The Y-like invalid initial glyph in YXAFF is transcribed as Y and conservatively masked. Supplying V at source index 60 gives the U in AUFBAU. It is one source-mask fill, with no observed-coordinate substitution.
The printed interception date is November 22d; the earlier OCR date November 23d is corrected against the image.
No relation to another Aufbau order, unit, station installation or missing second part is asserted solely from adjacency.
